Results.Title: General info and comparing to other grills I own.

Results.ReviewText:
Over time this grill has been my mainstay. I’ve owned three. By and large Weber has made incremental and effective modifications in the design over time.   Two complaints. The mechanism that sweeps the spent ash into the collecting bin will over time rust and fuse into place and cease to work. In addition Weber has removed the handle on the back making it more difficult to move over uneven surfaces. 

Be sure to buy and use the cover and Weber’s effective spray grill cleaner.  Any buildup of fat deposits will after a time become moldy. Reduce it by cleaning the grill surface after every one or two uses.
Results.Title: Care and complaints

Results.ReviewText: I'm 66 years old and have been grilling for 50 years. Two days ago my wife presented me with my third Weber kettle. There was nothing wrong at all with the other two, we simply wore them out cooking nearly every day during the summer and at least once every week in the winter.second kettle. Then, the limbs from a dead pine finally destroyed the second kettle and my wife bought me a third. I cook everything on the grill...meat, vegetables, pineapple, watermelon...you name it. If anybody out there decides to cook on charcoal, there is no other choice in grills.
Results.Title: On my third kettle

Results.ReviewText: Hubby put it together and it was fairly easy. I’ve only used it once. I grilled some steaks. I’m not sure if my charcoal was old or I didn’t put enough charcoal in but it seemed to take my steaks a long time to get a good sear. Anyhow the steaks were very good just a little overdone for me. They were a medium to medium well where I prefer medium rare. I’m sure with a few more times I will get it down.

Results.ReviewText: I love this grill with caveats!  For one who has always grilled on propane, this charcoal grill has opened up a whole new world of smoked flavors!  The reason that I am not giving Weber Kettle grill 5 stars is the location of the Temperature gauge.  I do not understand why the temperature gauge is not on the vent side (Indirect heat side) of the grill.  By putting the gauge opposite of the vent, Weber has basically rendered this gauge worthless!  The gauge should actually be below the vent so that you can get the indirect heat temp nearest the food!  Take a look at the new SNS grill - they got it right!  The other improvement needed is the fact that you have to upgrade to the Weber Master Touch model to get the lid holder.  This needs to be incorporated on the base Kettle model.
Results.Title: Love this Grill, but Temp Gauge on the WRONG side!

Results.Title: Worth the premium

Results.ReviewText:
Purchased a 22" charcoal kettle about a month ago. Revolutionary. Absolutely game changing. My family's culinary delights are reaching unprecedented new levels. I've grilled chops, chicken filets, salmon, steelhead trout, corn on the cob, potatoes, several veggies, even s'mores for dessert. When I bought this, I had essentially no experience grilling. It seems that this grill is very forgiving. I have yet to try anything that has completely failed. It's terrific for newbies (and, I gather, for seasoned grill masters as well). A Weber Kettle + a few minutes watching a YouTube video on whatever you want to grill and you're off to the races.

My only minor complaint is that the rotating vent on the lid does not have a handle. It gets very hot, which makes it difficult to turn the vent to reduce airflow while grilling. I have seen some people online proposing modifications to accommodate this but it seems like something Weber could address directly.

Nevertheless, this grill is terrific. 22" seems like a reasonable size for a small family. I can easily fit a grill basket and 3–4 chops. If I were grilling for more than about 4 people I'd consider getting a larger one, especially if I wanted to keep grilling side dishes in the basket.
Results.Title: Good food, good fun

Results.ReviewText: This is my second Weber in over 15+ years. The only reason for the new purchase was many years of Family Gatherings and Tailgating Etc has led to a few bumps and bruises on my old unit. So I thought it would be time to get a new toy.  I am disappointed in two things. The quality of the lid seems cheap. Doesn't have the same feel, or sound when placing lid back on. Does not feel as heavy either. Is this due to cheaper or thinner material? Second the lower vents do not adjust to the fully closed position. I assembled the unit with ease as I am very mechanically inclined. This flaw in the lower vent is very disappointing as I am unable to completely close it off.  Please let me know how we can correct this. Thank you

14401001.Description: Some things never go out of style—like the smoky flavor of charcoal, the sizzle of a summer cookout, and the iconic silhouette of the 22" Original Kettle® Premium Charcoal Grill. This grill features a built-in lid thermometer to monitor the temperature inside the grill, and a hinged, plated-steel cooking grate flips up on either side allowing you to easily add more fuel while cooking. Like all Weber® kettles, it’s built to last with a porcelain-enameled bowl and lid that retains heat and resist rust, peeling, and scratching, and adjustable lid and bowl dampers to fine-tune the heat for perfect results. When it’s time to clean up, the One-Touch™ cleaning system makes it neat and effortless—just swipe the lever to clear ashes into the enclosed, high-capacity ash catcher. Two wheels make it easy to roll this timeless classic to the center of the action, right where it belongs.
